blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 4 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (2) which identity document is accepted (passport, national identity card or driving licence); (3) how long verification takes (a complete document set is normally reviewed within up to 10 days); (4) where to turn when the login still fails (customer support: live chat 24/7 or e-mail; do not print the e-mail address). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
